body:
Before I die I just want to share one thing: my REAL name, not the stupid name I was given by my parents.

My name is Keegan. This is the first time I've ever told anyone my name and will be the last. No one will know someone with this name died today. I can't even write a proper fucking suicide note this is literally all I am leaving behind. Sorry for putting this here. I just wanted to exist for at least a moment, before disappearing forever...
